title: French demonstrations escalating up to Atomic Energy officials

tellings.quote: The people in France are writing to Jacques and they're saying, "We're inviting so-and-so to see a demonstration." Well, each of those demonstrations was a level higher,

plain: In France in 1956, demonstrations of the American inventor Townsend Brown's devices, which the episode presents as early UFO-like technology, are said to have climbed step by step to ever more senior audiences, up to officials in atomic energy. A researcher named Jan Lundquist tells Michels this, without naming a source, from the letters that people in France wrote to a witness named Jacques Cornillon, saying "We're inviting so-and-so to see a demonstration," with "each of those demonstrations" a "level higher"; if true, it would mean the work drew serious official interest.
